passages.text: Bhakti-Yoga is a real, genuine search after the Lord, a search beginning, continuing, and ending in love. One single moment of the madness of extreme love to God brings us eternal freedom.
passages.note: Spiritual seeking through love and devotion

passages.text: All the weak and undeveloped minds in every religion or country have only one way of loving their own ideal, i.e. by hating every other ideal.
passages.note: Intolerance; loving one's own by hating others

passages.text: Three things are necessary for a bird to fly — the two wings and the tail as a rudder for steering. Jnana (Knowledge) is the one wing, Bhakti (Love) is the other, and Yoga is the tail that keeps up the balance.
passages.note: Balancing head, heart and practice in life

passages.text: That deathless love which the ignorant have for the fleeting objects of the senses — as I keep meditating on Thee — may not that love slip away from my heart!
passages.note: Prayer to keep devotion as strong as desire
